text: The firmware folks and the app folks are using 'connected' to mean different things, which is why I'm drawing this. We start Disconnected. A connect request takes us to Connecting; a successful handshake takes us to Ready. Don't call that state Connected. If the handshake times out, we go back to Disconnected. Once Ready, a lost connection sends us to Retrying, and a successful retry goes to Ready again. After three failures we give up and go to Disconnected. Put the three-failure condition on the arrow rather than making another state for it. I may be missing a cancellation path. Leave that as a note beside Connecting so we remember to ask.

wires.span: We start Disconnected
A connect request takes us to Connecting
a successful handshake takes us to Ready
If the handshake times out, we go back to Disconnected
Once Ready, a lost connection sends us to Retrying
a successful retry goes to Ready again
After three failures we give up and go to Disconnected
Leave that as a note beside Connecting so we remember to ask
